rules.description: Kinesis: Left Control tap Escape, hold Control
Laptop: Caps Lock tap Escape, hold Control
Laptop: Right Command is always nav layer while held
Kinesis: Enter instant nav layer, tap Enter if unused
Kinesis: End instant nav layer, tap End if unused
Nav layer: hjkl to arrows (with Control held → Option+arrow for word jump)
Control to Command: copy, paste, cut, undo, redo, select all (except in terminals)
Kinesis: caps and arrow key symbols
Kinesis: Page Down / Page Up hold keypad layer
